alternatives_rejected.why: This is a downstream symptom rather than a root cause. The origin is productcatalogservice, whose inbound call latency rose 2.65x (E2) alongside its disk I/O anomaly (E1).

proposed_fix.description: First find the source of the abnormal disk I/O on the productcatalogservice pod or node, such as a noisy neighbor, log flooding, or a disk-stress process, and throttle or remove it. Serve the catalog from memory rather than repeated disk reads. Then scale out productcatalogservice replicas onto healthy nodes and confirm that latency-90 returns to baseline.
